lessons.title: Limits and Intuition
lessons.focus: Introduce the concept of a limit, how to estimate limits graphically and numerically, and why limits are fundamental to calculus.

lessons.title: Formal Definition of Limits
lessons.focus: Explain ε‑δ definition, work through simple proofs, and practice finding limits using the definition.

lessons.title: Continuity
lessons.focus: Define continuity at a point and on intervals, explore the relationship between limits and continuity, and identify discontinuities.

lessons.title: Derivatives: Concept and Notation
lessons.focus: Present the derivative as a rate of change and slope of a tangent line, introduce notation (f′, dy/dx) and basic interpretation.

lessons.title: Derivative Rules
lessons.focus: Teach power, constant, sum, product, quotient, and chain rules with step‑by‑step examples.

lessons.title: Applications of Derivatives
lessons.focus: Use derivatives for tangent lines, velocity, optimization problems, and related rates.

lessons.title: Integrals: Antiderivatives
lessons.focus: Introduce indefinite integrals, the connection to derivatives, and basic integration rules.

lessons.title: Definite Integrals and Area
lessons.focus: Define the definite integral as a limit of Riemann sums, compute areas under curves, and apply the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus.

lessons.title: Techniques of Integration
lessons.focus: Cover substitution, integration by parts, partial fractions, and numerical integration methods.

lessons.title: and integrals to real‑world problems in physics
reinforcing confidence in using calculus tools.
